description: S04 gold-evaluation corpus: 4 official vendor datasheets (1 MPS + 2 TI + 1 ADI) covering distinct converter feature families. Data/raw is git-ignored; this manifest is the durable pointer that binds gold spans to PDFs by source_id + sha256 + page.
notes: Each sha256 and pdf_pages value was recomputed from the local PDF on 2026-09-06; source_verified=true means the file on disk matches the recorded hash, not that human review has approved the content.
All four documents were human-approved on 2026-09-07 after official-domain URL, product, revision, local page count, and SHA-256 review.
Themes present per document mirror topic_inventory.md PRESENT cells. AMBIGUOUS/NOT_FOUND themes carry no gold-answerable claims.
The TPS562201 datasheet (SLVSD91D) is a family sheet covering TPS562201 and TPS562208; product-scoped gold spans must bind to the exact product the claim is about.
SKU MP4570GF-Z is the packaged variant of product MP4570; S04 queries bind to the canonical product id MP4570.

Datasheet states wide 4.5V-55V input range with 60V absolute maximum; P4 Recommended Operating Conditions gives Output Voltage VOUT = 1V to 0.9*VIN (output_range theme PRESENT, corrected after line-level review of P4).
No dedicated EMI section or hiccup terminology was found. Output-short behavior is nevertheless PRESENT: P15 describes SS discharge/restart and P16 describes FB-dependent current-limit reduction.

documents.document_title: TPS54331 3-A, 28-V Input, Step Down DC-DC Converter With Eco-mode datasheet (Rev. H)
notes: TI datasheet SLVS839H; first issue July 2008, latest revision October 2023 (the revision date is recorded as document_date).
Soft-start is documented with the term 'slow start' (adjustable via external SS capacitor, 1-10 ms, CSS <= 27 nF); the device has no internal slow-start time.

Protection family differs from the other chips: OVTP is an overvoltage *transient* protection (109%/107% of VREF), short-circuit handling is frequency foldback (divide-by-2/4/8) - do not paraphrase as a general OVP/hiccup scheme.
No power-good or external-clock synchronization description was located in this revision; absence-oriented cases must report NOT_FOUND/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE rather than assert nonexistence.

documents.document_title: TPS56220x 4.5V to 17V Input, 2A Synchronous Step-Down Voltage Regulator in SOT-23 datasheet (Rev. D)
notes: Family sheet covers TPS562201 (pulse-skip / Advanced Eco-mode) and TPS562208 (FCCM continuous mode); the two differ in light-load behavior and shutdown-related specs, so product binding matters in gold.

The spec table section header says 'OUTPUT UNDERVOLTAGE AND OVERVOLTAGE PROTECTION' but contains only VUVP/hiccup rows - no output-overvoltage threshold or description exists in this revision, so overvoltage_protection is AMBIGUOUS (header-only) and must not yield answerable gold.
No power-good or external-clock synchronization description was located in this revision; absence alone must not be promoted to a positive nonexistence claim.
Dedicated EMI discussion is absent; only the layout guideline about radiated emissions exists (see layout_guidelines).

documents.document_title: LT8610 42V, 2.5A Synchronous Step-Down Regulator with 2.5uA Quiescent Current
notes: Rev. D of the LT8610 data sheet; dated 2024-08.
Input range stated as 3.4V to 42V (features page); VIN UVLO and EN/UV threshold (1V) behavior are separate enable/UVLO topics.
No output-overvoltage protection wording and no user bootstrap component (internal) - those themes are NOT_FOUND and must not yield answerable gold.
Output voltage has no explicit numeric range row; output is set by FB divider against the ~0.97V reference. Efficiency curves exist as images only; no numeric efficiency claims are text-gold-able.
